document.title: Parents and their children’s crimes
document.question:
When children and teenagers commit crimes, some people believe that their parents should be punished by law. They argue that parents are responsible for their children’s behaviour.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
